iris-docs: Hey team — my docs PR (#462) failed the CI docs build. Error mentions duplicate anchors and two missing images. Works fine on my laptop. Anyone seen the Mac vs CI mismatch before? ci-bot: ci-bot: docs-site build failed: Error: duplicate anchor 'getting-started' at /docs/overview/getting-started.md:30 trevor-fe: This usually means slug normalization differences. Emoji-prefixed headings and plain headings can collapse to the same slug depending on Node/ICU and the slugger used. iris-docs: In my file there is "🚀 Getting Started" and also a plain "Getting Started" in another doc. On GitHub both show fine but Docusaurus on CI errors out. bryce-infra: The CI image uses Alpine and a different Node build of ICU which can change how non-ascii chars are handled when slugifying. Two quick options: add an explicit id to the heading, e.g. `

🚀 Getting Started

`, or change docusaurus config to use a deterministic slugger: `slugify: s => require('github-slugger').slug(s)`. jen-qa: Linkcheck output: `linkcheck: 3 broken links, 2 missing images: /static/img/arch-labs.png, /static/img/flowchart.svg`. Those images are symlinks into `../shared/diagrams/`. CI's checkout doesn't include symlink targets so they 404. iris-docs: The images were symlinked from the monorepo's shared folder to avoid copying. If CI doesn't preserve symlinks we need a fix. bryce-infra: Short-term: vendor-copy the missing images into `docs/static/img/` in your PR to unblock. Long-term: update the docs workflow to dereference symlinks before build: for example `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` or use `tar --dereference` when packaging. I'll open a small infra PR for the workflow change. trevor-fe: Also recommend adding `remark-slug` + `remark-unique-headers` to the docs lint so duplicate anchors are caught pre-merge. We can also normalize invisible unicode: strip zero-width chars (U+200B) before slugging. Example plugin snippet: `slugify: s => require('github-slugger').slug(s.normalize('NFKD').replace(/\u200B/g, ''))`. jen-qa: If you vendor-copy the diagrams, please include a checksum test in `docs/tests` so we detect drift later. I'll add `yarn docs:linkcheck` to the local test matrix so QA can run it before approving. bryce-infra: For the CI change I'll include a debugging helper that prints out the exact file and header line causing duplicate anchors to make fixes easier: `grep -n "^##\|
